title: Public counters — /stats.json
description:
The public counter artifact, with an explicit three-state machine so that a number's ABSENCE is a documented state rather than a bug (WEB-060/061, FS-10 §10).

`state` is computed from real registry and ledger facts and is never set by hand:
  · `pre-launch` — mechanism copy only. Every numeric field is null. No letter-of-intent counts, no progress bar.
  · `launched-pre-disbursement` — projects, contributors and companies are real; `chfRoutedMinor` stays NULL with `firstDisbursementScheduledFor` naming the date. 'CHF 0' is never rendered, neither as an achievement nor as an embarrassment.
  · `post-first-franc` — every figure is real and `chfRoutedMinor` is the ledger total.

A field may be null in any state where the underlying thing does not yet exist: at P-M2 `contributorsClaimed` is null because there is no claim flow to claim through, and the page labels it as the structural zero it is (VS-19).

Rendering rules travel with the data: a `computedAt` caption, deep links to the source surfaces, no upward animation from zero, and `prefers-reduced-motion` honoured (WEB-062/063, WEB-121).

generatedAt.description: Rendered as the `computedAt` caption. A counter without its timestamp is a claim without a date.

state.description: The machine state. The prose labels S1/S2/S3 stay prose and never appear in this artifact (FS01-050).

contributorsClaimed.description: Null until the claim flow exists — an honest structural zero, labelled as such on the page (VS-19).

chfRoutedMinor.description: Ledger total in minor units. NULL, never 0, before the first disbursement.

cur.description: Reporting currency for `chfRoutedMinor` (CHF; the final ruling is URS §21 OPEN-26).

firstDisbursementScheduledFor.description: Set in `launched-pre-disbursement` so the empty money figure has a date attached instead of a shrug.

loi.description: Letter-of-intent counts. Stays NULL unless the escrow-visibility decision resolves to public (URS §21 OPEN-17, default: silent); then it carries counts from real signed letters only.

detectedUnclaimed.description: Repositories detected but never claimed. Aggregate only — detected repositories are never listed (GH-014).

smallnessThresholds.description: Below these counts the page states the number in words with context rather than as a headline figure — small numbers are told, not dressed up (WEB-061).

links.description: Deep links to the surfaces each counter comes from. A counter that cannot be traced to its source surface is not published (WEB-062).

allOf.$comment: WEB-061 S1: in pre-launch every numeric field is null. Enforced structurally so a build cannot ship a pre-launch page with a number on it. OPEN CONFLICT FOR A HUMAN TO SETTLE: the illustrative artifact in FS-10 §10 (FS10-080) shows these fields as 0 while pre-launch, whereas VS-19 states them as null and the honesty law forbids rendering 'CHF 0' either as achievement or as embarrassment. This schema implements VS-19; if the FS-10 example is meant literally, this rule is what must change, and it must change here first. See CHANGELOG.md.
WEB-061 S2: money stays null and the first-disbursement date must be named.
WEB-061 S3: post-first-franc, the money figure is real.
